answer_1.quote: This study proposes a method for selecting knowledge based on both its relevance to the dialogue and its interestingness, allowing us the generation of responses that facilitate coherence and interest.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation We use the accuracy (ACC) score... perplexity (PPL)... unigram F1 (F1), BLEU-4, ROUGE-2, and distinct score (Dist-2).

answer_3.quote: G-Eval was used to evaluate the fluency (Flu.), coherence (Coh.), informativeness (Inf.), and interestingness (Int.) of the responses... MEEP evaluates response engagement... The LLM used was GPT-4o.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation A/B tests... using the crowdsourcing site Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT)... three annotators for each response... The same evaluation metrics were adopted as those used during the evaluation with G-Eval... rated on a five-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: evaluating responses using metrics: Fluency, Coherence, Informativeness, and Interestingness on a five-point Likert scale
